subject: [PATCH v4 09/13] mm/collapse: separate scanning a PTE table from collapsing it

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: Author agreed to rename a function namespace in response to feedback about inconsistent naming conventions.
reviews.raw_body:
Fine with me.

collapse_file() has been using collapse as the verb all along, so my
namespace argument was not much of one.

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch separates the scanning of a PTE table from collapsing it into two distinct functions: collapse_scan_pmd() and collapse_run_pmd(). The scan function determines whether a range is worth collapsing, while the run function performs the actual collapse. This change improves performance by reducing the number of times the mmap_lock is dropped and taken, and also simplifies the code by breaking down complex operations into smaller, more manageable pieces.
